summary: Long-range ship radio: frequencies, signals, DSC, SITOR, receiver, transmitter, antenna and faults.

blocks.title: Reach
items: 2 MHz ground wave: about 100 to 150 nm by day.
2182 kHz by day: no contact at 60 miles is a malfunction; at 600 nm it's normal.
DSC, digital selective calling, makes the call; then a follow-on frequency carries voice or SITOR (NBDP), radio telex.

head: Code
What it is
rows: SSB, carrier suppressed: 2.8 kHz wide, 3.0 kHz spacing
SITOR on SSB tones: 300 Hz wide, 500 Hz spacing

blocks.title: Transmitter and antenna
items: Tolerance: 10 Hz. With a 2 ppm counter, pick 2182.006 and 4124.995 kHz.
First call: 150 W PEP, peak envelope power.
PLL synthesizer: master oscillator, frequency dividers, phase comparator, loop filter, VCO. Comparator: both divided outputs.
Tuner: matches the antenna to the operating frequency.
Series L electrically lengthens; series C shortens.
Use RG-8 50 ohm coax, PL-259. Whip lost: 35-40 ft wire.

blocks.title: DSC call
items: Dot pattern of 200 bits precedes phasing. 10-bit code: 7 information, 3 error correction.
Distress: MMSI, position, nature, follow-on by J3E or F1B.
MMSI 003669999: all Coast Guard coast stations; may test equipment.

blocks.title: SITOR telex
items: ARQ: two-way. ISS sends 3 characters; IRS checks parity, then proceed or resend.
FEC: one-way to all; each character twice.
SFEC: one-way to 1 station keeping radio silence.
ISS, IRS: information sending, receiving station.
Commands end in +: HELP+, MSG+, AMV+, OPR+.
Direct: DIRTLX0xxyyyy+; KKKK ends it.
MSI: always FEC TELEX: 518 kHz within NAVTEX range, else 1 of 8 HF frequencies.

blocks.title: Exam traps
items: Fluctuating 0 to 150 W: proper in ARQ, improper in FEC.
Spectrum analyzer deviation test isn't valid for F1B.
4:3 ratio code: SITOR, not DSC.
